decisions.title: Model structure and algorithm
chosen: A. Tweedie GBM per line (LightGBM, power ≈ 1.5, exposure offset)
decisions.other: does PCA model help to better identify the factors?   you should try to train different models and choose the optimial one based on the kaggle score.

decisions.title: Feature set (choose all that apply)
chosen: A. Policy + customer + address + same-year weather (cleaned, leakage excluded)
B. Experience rating: prior claims of the same policy / customer, across all lines

decisions.title: Immature 2024 claims (late reporting and open claims)
chosen: B. Develop to ultimate: IBNR count factors from report lags + severity uplift for open / late claims

decisions.title: Validation scheme
chosen: C. K-fold grouped by policy across all years

decisions.title: Large-loss treatment
chosen: B. Cap per line (e.g. 99.5th pct); spread the excess as a loading

decisions.title: Trend and calibration to the 2025 level
chosen: D. Use the premium change (+3–6 %) as the inflation index

decisions.title: Training window and year weighting
chosen: B. All years, 2024 down-weighted by maturity

decisions.title: Separate models per line or one pooled model
Ensembling and choosing the final submission
chosen: B. Blend GLM + GBM (weights chosen on our validation)
decisions.other: does PCA model help to better identify the factors?

decisions.title: Exposure handling
chosen: A. log(exposure) offset, with new_business as a feature

decisions.title: Data-quality fixes
chosen: A. Fix as in src/data.py (pad ids, recompute exposure, ÷1000 sum insured, normalise labels, dedupe)

decisions.title: How we show effective, verified AI use (choose all that apply)
chosen: C. Automated tests (pytest) for data fixes, leakage and submission format
